## Request Context

Developer requested execution of Phase 0 (gate plumbing) of SPEC-20260714-220401-repocademy (spec lives in the insight_journal repo; this repo owns the cross-repo contract per spec section 5). Scope: docs/education/gates.yaml registry seeded from real deferral archaeology (HANDOFF-supervisor-rolling 3.x/4.1-4.4 cohort + D2-backflow walkthrough deferral); scripts/education/gate_registry.py (library + CLI); scripts/education/ingest_walkthrough_session.py (untrusted-transcript chokepoint: schema-validated, all-or-nothing, idempotent writes to discussion + events + education_results + registry flip); docs/education/CONTRACTS.md (versioned formats the phone app builds against); ADR-0029 (scope: hybrid); tests with >=80% coverage explicitly wired (gate coverage currently measures only src/). Constraints: branch feat/education-gate-registry off origin/main in a worktree (eval-suite tree untouched); D1-D16 locked; no watcher built here (Phase 2, other repo); write_event.py positional signature + fixed 7-intent enum; reuse record_education.py enums; security review mandatory on ingest script; implementation + reviews at opus tier; push branch + open PR to main, NO merge without developer approval. Orchestrator: Fable 5 main session as facilitator.

Task A delivered: docs/education/gates.yaml (7 gates seeded from REV/handoff/walkthrough archaeology), scripts/education/gate_registry.py (validated load/save-atomic/list/get/add/clear/re-defer + CLI), tests/test_gate_registry.py (55 tests, 99% cov, ruff clean). Key judgment calls: units 3.1/3.2 OMITTED — REV-20260609-052616 has no Education Gate section and REV-20260609-060229 records the gate as waived ('Not needed'), so seeding them would fabricate deferrals; unit 4.3 scope.spec set to phase spec SPEC-20260607-183136 (no per-unit spec exists); d2-backflow gate scoped via ADRs 0022/0023/0024 + optional branch field (walkthrough names no concrete file paths). clear_gate idempotency contract: already-cleared gate is a no-op returning (gate, False), preserving original cleared_by.

Checkpoint A Round 1: APPROVE (confidence 0.83). Strict unknown-key rejection is right for the authoritative writer; version field is the forward-compat escape hatch — but CONTRACTS.md must state the phone app is a TOLERANT READER (ignore unknown keys). Advisories for Task B: (1) no lock on load-mutate-save — concurrent CLI add + ingest clear = lost update; consider lockfile when wiring ingest; (2) re_defer_gate drops cleared_by with no transition record — lineage lives only in events; acceptable if contract is current-state-only, note it.

Checkpoint A Round 1: REVISE (confidence 0.88). Verified 55 tests pass, 99% cov, seeded gates.yaml validates. Assertion quality strong (double-clear deep-copy check, atomic-save failure injection, bool-version rejection). ONE GAP: corrupt/malformed YAML is unhandled — yaml.YAMLError escapes load_registry as a raw traceback (exit 1) instead of the clean error/exit-2 path. Fix: re-raise yaml.YAMLError as ValueError in load_registry + test_load_corrupt_yaml. Matters because the ingest script (next consumer) must reject a hand-broken registry cleanly.

Checkpoint A Round 2: APPROVE. Fix verified: load_registry wraps yaml.safe_load, re-raises yaml.YAMLError as ValueError with chained exc; CLI reproduces clean error/exit-2 on corrupt file; test_load_corrupt_yaml would fail under old code; 56 passed. Non-blocking advisory: test could also assert the path appears in the message.

Task B delivered: docs/education/CONTRACTS.md (transcript JSON v1 + course/chapter frontmatter v1 + knowledge-note v1 + versioning policy + tolerant-reader/strict-writer split); scripts/education/ingest_walkthrough_session.py (pure validate_transcript -> registry+idempotency guard -> create_discussion -> sequential write_event turns -> single-txn education rows -> registry flip LAST; compensation deletes rows+discussion on post-validation failure; documented non-atomic window chooses under-clearing over false-clearing); tests/test_ingest_walkthrough_session.py (36 tests: all-five-shapes e2e, idempotent re-run, session-deferral re-defer, below-threshold recorded-open, learn-mode-never-clears guard, clamping, 8 atomic-rejection variants asserting zero writes + byte-identical registry, compensation injection). record_education.py enums hoisted to BLOOM_LEVELS/QUESTION_TYPES (single source). Coverage wired: quality_gate check_coverage += --cov=scripts/education, pyproject source += scripts/education. Full suite 1465 passed, combined 96.79%, ingest file 91%.

Checkpoint B Round 1: APPROVE. Probed path traversal (charset allows dots but gate_id embeds in DISC-<ts>-education-<id> never bare component + must pre-exist in registry; session_id never touches paths), false-clearing (_decide recomputes walked AND avg>=0.70 AND explain-back AND mode==gate; outcome.status never trusted; empty terminal scores fails closed; variant_of can only exclude), idempotency abuse (first education_results row locks session_id to no-op; cleared_by never overwritten), atomicity/injection (validate-before-write pure; temp+os.replace+fsync; parameterized SQL; YAML safe_dump). Non-blocking: repo_slug validated but unused — confirm no future sink; unbounded events list mild DoS accepted under single-writer; implementer concerns 1-7 all correctly reasoned.

Checkpoint B Round 1: REVISE (confidence 0.86). Verified 99 subset / 1465 full suite green, wiring measures scripts/education (ingest 91%, registry 99%). Finding 1: coverage enforcement is AGGREGATE — src (97%) dominates --cov-fail-under=80 so ingest could regress to 40% and stay green; add per-path floor coverage report --include=scripts/education/* --fail-under=80. Finding 2: PASS_THRESHOLD >= 0.70 used in _grade_text/_education_rows/_decide is untested at the boundary; add quiz_item score exactly 0.70 asserting passed=1 + cleared. Advisory: empty events[], narration-only, duplicate item_id, completed_at<started_at unvalidated.

Checkpoint B Round 2: APPROVE (confidence 0.92). Both fixes verified directly: (1) check_coverage second assertion coverage report --include=scripts/education/* --fail-under=80 against same .coverage data — isolated report reads 94%, a scripts/education-confined regression now fails independently of green aggregate TOTAL; (2) TestPassThresholdBoundary pins 0.70 (passed=1 x3, cleared) and 0.69 (passed=0, recorded-open, gate open) — closes the >= boundary gap on _decide. 38 passed. No new gaps introduced.

ADR-0029-repocademy-education-gates.md written (scope: hybrid, status: accepted, discussion_id links this build discussion, spec_id references external SPEC-20260714-220401-repocademy). Verified against check_adrs parsing logic: required fields + sections present, PASS. House style matched to ADR-0027/0028 (Alternatives Considered last). Documents: registry decision, deterministic-chokepoint trust boundary (LLM-mediated writes rejected as alternative), tolerant-reader/strict-writer split, under-clearing failure direction, deferred lockfile per Principle 8, isolated coverage floor.

REV panel: APPROVE-WITH-CHANGES (0.81). Suite 1467 green, new-code 94%, gate 7/7. MED: (Q1) BLOOM_LEVELS/QUESTION_TYPES claimed single-source but nothing binds them to init_db DDL CHECK enums — add set-equality test; (Q2) new isolated-floor branch in check_coverage untested — no proof it fails <80 or that --include glob matches. LOW: (Q3) recorded-open re-run dedup path unasserted; (Q4) multi-level variant chains untested. INFO: registry lock before Phase-2 batching.

REV panel: APPROVE-WITH-CHANGES (0.83). MED: (A1) validator accepts deferral.item_ref but CONTRACTS 1.2 omits it — phone cannot know it exists; (A2) _decide checks session-deferral before mode so a learn-mode transcript can re-defer the registry, contradicting ADR 'learn never touches registry' — pin precedence; (A3) CONTRACTS 1.4 overstates 'recomputes authoritative decision' — per-item scores are producer-authoritative, only the aggregate is recomputed; (A4) zero-education-row session (deferral before any narration) escapes idempotency guard — re-ingest duplicates the discussion; (A5→advisory) module-global mutation of create_discussion/write_event privates — parametrize later. LOW: quiz.contract_version independence unclear. INFO: __init__.py dilutes isolated floor harmlessly.

REV panel: APPROVE-WITH-CHANGES (0.82). No injection or gate-bypass; validate-before-write purity, recomputed clearing, parameterized SQL, safe_load/dump, charset IDs, fsync atomic registry all verified. MED: (S1) NO resource caps on untrusted input — unbounded events count, uncapped string fields, unbounded ID length, read_text before size check; checkpoint flag not addressed and no accepted-risk note; add file-size guard + MAX_EVENTS + string/ID length caps, document in CONTRACTS 1.1; (S2) stored second-order prompt-injection surface unnamed — event content flows to events.jsonl then transcript generation/findings extraction/Phase-2 LLM contexts; name it + downstream data-not-instructions obligation in CONTRACTS 1.5 + ADR. LOW: (S3) create_discussion stdout pollution breaks watcher stdout contract. INFO: (S4) repo_slug validated-not-consumed note. Existing posture not weakened; quality_gate change strengthens.

REV panel: APPROVE-WITH-CHANGES (0.78). HIGH: (IP1) airtight vs injection, wide open vs grade inflation — scores are phone-LLM self-reports auto-clearing a gate with zero human loop; name accepted risk in ADR + decide auto-clear vs human-confirm; (IP2) clearing automated but ENROLLING not — nothing calls add_gate on future /review deferrals; registry drifts back to prose invisibility; wire or track follow-up; (IP3) phone builds against prose — commit conformance fixture transcript_v1_valid.json golden + optional JSON Schema. MED: (IP4) session_id uniqueness is producer article of faith — state obligation + log no-op short-circuits observably; (IP5) education turns wear review intents (proposal/evidence) — mining views may count them as review activity; verify filters + ADR note. LOW: (IP6) compensation swallows sqlite3.Error silently — log stderr; (IP7) global-mutation comment. INFO: deferral framing shame-free, compliant.

All 14 review folds landed, nothing deferred. Key: learn-mode precedence pinned (mode!=gate never touches registry, test asserts byte-identical); zero-row idempotency closed via session-embedded slug + substr(discussion_id,22) exact match (deliberately NOT LIKE — underscore is both legal in IDs and a LIKE metachar); resource caps MAX_TRANSCRIPT_BYTES=2MB/MAX_EVENTS=500/MAX_TEXT_LEN=20k/MAX_ID_LEN=128 with atomic-rejection tests; compensation failures now stderr-observable; stdout discipline (exactly one summary line, tested); conformance fixture docs/education/fixtures/transcript_v1_valid.json as golden; enum-DDL set-equality pin via sqlite_master; isolated-floor gate branch tested incl. zero-match glob guard; CONTRACTS + ADR corrected (producer-authoritative scores, stored prompt-injection surface named, grade-inflation accepted-risk documented, enrollment-automation follow-up tracked, command_type=education filter obligation). Also fixed 3 pre-existing E501s in quality_gate.py. Verification: 143 tests in touched files; full suite 1483 passed; aggregate 96.92%; scripts/education isolated 95% (floor 80).

Review synthesis: REV-20260715-001650 verdict APPROVE (post-fold), weighted confidence 0.81. Pre-fold 4x approve-with-changes, 0 blocking. 14 findings folded and re-verified in-session; 4 open advisories carried (enrollment automation wiring, parametrize create_discussion/write_event paths, registry lockfile before Phase-2 batching, __init__ floor dilution INFO). Suite 1483 passed / 96.92% aggregate / 95% isolated education floor. Principle #4 satisfied: distinct generation, checkpoint, and review agents; independent-perspective non-participating.
